lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.17 - A Look and write

details: Look and write checks understanding of new vocabulary. Write tests students’ ability to write a word or phrase correctly using clues and visuals.
Look for correct choices, accurate spelling and careful penmanship.
“I’m packing to go on a trip and I want to take all my favourite clothes. Will you  help me find them?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.18 - Speaking Look at the picture below. Ask and answer.Then write the kids’ names. Ask and answer to find the lost things. Then draw them on their owners.

details: Ask and answer gives students practice using the target language to ask and respond to simple questions to build confidence.
Look for correct use of the question, clear and accurate answers and turn taking, as well as accurate labeling of characters and drawing of objects.
“I’m going on a trip with some new friends. Will you help me learn their names, and what things they each have?”
